tasks.title: Audit repaired login autosave and open-world slice
tasks.notes: [claude review] Read-only audit, no source changed. SAVE: (1) per-action SaveProgress writes the full JSON blob synchronously on every gather/craft/combat/quest/appearance change - IO-heavy under rapid actions; debounce or rely on the 10s autosave + a dirty flag. (2) Username normalization mismatch: LoginScreen.OnLogin validates raw text but sets Session.Username=Trim() while SaveService.BuildSavePath lowercases+sanitizes, so case/space-variant logins can share one save file or save under a different identity than validated - normalize once at the auth boundary. (3) Close-time save (NotificationWMCloseRequest) will not fire on hard kill/mobile/web; final <=10s delta then relies on autosave. (4) Only _mainQuest is persisted; multi-quest needs a collection in SaveGame. LAYOUT: (5) LoginScreen is responsive (FullRect+ScrollContainer+KeepAspectCentered logo) - original logo-spill fixed. (6) GameManager prototype HUD action buttons use absolute Position/Size (AddHudButton) - can spill/overlap at small sizes or high DPI; corner labels/bars are anchored. Migrate per docs/HUD_ARCHITECTURE.md. LIFECYCLE: (7) bus subscriptions disposed on Predelete (good); ProcessLocalTick does a per-tick GetNodeOrNull lookup - cache the PlayerController. PERF: (8) OpenWorldBuilder spawns ~228 MeshInstance3D, each with its own StandardMaterial3D, no MultiMesh/shared materials/instancing - draw-call heavy; (9) HumanoidVisual rebuilds 7 parts + new materials on each Apply and per NPC _Ready - share materials/pool; (10) ChunkInterestManager not yet gating scenery/NPCs. TESTS MISSING: SaveService.BuildSavePath + legacy migration; GameManager save/load round-trip (extract a pure mapping to unit-test); login-normalization consistency.
verification: read-only audit; no source changed; findings in notes
